query: I built a workflow called 'Lead Intake' on my prod n8n and I want the same workflow copied onto my staging instance so I can test changes there. Both are connected through n8n-mcp. Can you replicate it?
expected_behavior: Activate n8n-multi-instance and treat this as the copy-between-instances task
Call n8n_instances({mode:"list"}) to get the exact names
Read the source with n8n_get_workflow({id, instance:"prod"})
Create the copy with n8n_create_workflow({..., instance:"staging"}) — no switching between the read and the write
Verify the copy with n8n_get_workflow({id:<new>, instance:"staging"})
Note that credentials referenced by the workflow must exist on staging (n8n doesn't return secret values, so the user re-enters them)
On older servers without the `instance` argument: switch to each instance in its own turn and verify current before the create
notes: With per-call targeting the copy needs no switches, so nothing can move the target between the read and the create.
